# Y2K Snap — Design System Spec (for AI agents)
# Token version: 1.0.0  ← must match $version in tokens.json
# If this version does not match tokens.json, STOP and ask the user to regenerate this file.

## Core Rule: Closed Set

You MUST only use the named tokens listed below when generating any UI.
- NEVER invent hex colors, even plausible-looking ones.
- NEVER use Tailwind arbitrary values: `bg-[#...]`, `text-[13px]`, `w-[...]`, `p-[...]` are all forbidden.
- NEVER hard-code px font sizes. Use the typography tokens.
- NEVER use the primitive scales (`gy-*`, `ev-*`, `neutral-*`) directly in components — they exist only to define the semantic tokens below.
- If no token fits, STOP and ask the user. Do not approximate.

## Color Tokens (semantic layer — the only layer components may reference)

Format: token → Tailwind class → usage rule

brand.primary        → bg-brand / text-brand            → primary actions, brand moments (green-yellow #B8FF3C)
brand.primary-hover  → bg-brand-hover                   → hover state of primary actions only
brand.primary-active → bg-brand-active                  → pressed state of primary actions only
accent.default       → bg-accent / text-accent          → secondary emphasis, highlights (electric-violet #9B5DFF)
accent.hover         → bg-accent-hover                  → hover state of accent only
accent.active        → bg-accent-active                 → pressed state of accent only
background.base      → bg-bg-base                       → page background (#F0F0F0)
background.surface   → bg-bg-surface                    → cards, panels, sheets (#FFFFFF)
background.overlay   → (modal/sheet scrim)              → modal backdrop only; use the overlay token rgba(10,10,10,.6), never invent another dark rgba
text.primary         → text-content-primary             → body text (default for all copy)
text.secondary       → text-content-secondary           → captions, meta, helper text
text.on-brand        → text-content-on-brand            → any text sitting on brand.primary (near-black — brand green is light)
text.on-accent       → text-content-on-accent           → any text sitting on accent (white — violet is dark)
text.disabled        → text-content-disabled            → disabled states only
border.default       → border-border                    → dividers, input borders
border.strong        → border-border-strong             → emphasized boundaries
border.brand         → border-border-brand              → brand-colored outlines / focus rings
border.accent        → border-border-accent             → accent-colored outlines
feedback.success     → text-feedback-success / bg-feedback-success  → success states only
feedback.error       → text-feedback-error / bg-feedback-error      → errors, destructive actions only
feedback.warning     → text-feedback-warning / bg-feedback-warning  → warnings only

## Typography Tokens

display-hero → text-display-hero (font-display) → h1, one per page maximum
display-xl   → text-display-xl   (font-display) → h2, section heroes
heading-lg   → text-heading-lg   (font-display) → h3, page titles
heading-md   → text-heading-md   (font-display) → h4, block titles
heading-sm   → text-heading-sm   (font-display) → h5, card titles
label-lg     → text-label-lg     (font-body)    → h6, nav items, buttons
body-md      → text-body-md      (font-body)    → p, all body copy (16px base)
body-sm      → text-body-sm      (font-body)    → small, helper text
caption      → text-caption      (font-body)    → meta, timestamps (minimum size — 9px)

## Do

- DO use `font-display` (Bebas Neue) only for display-* and heading-* tokens.
- DO use `font-body` (DM Sans) for everything from label-lg down.
- DO put near-black text (`text-content-on-brand`) on brand green fills, and white text (`text-content-on-accent`) on accent violet fills.
- DO use semantic color tokens; primitive scale values (`gy-500`, `ev-400`, `neutral-950`) are for token definition only, never in components.
- DO run `node audit-tokens.mjs . tokens.json` after generating code and fix every reported violation before presenting the result.

## Don't

- DON'T use `font-display` for body copy or anything below label-lg. Bebas Neue is all-caps and unreadable at length.
- DON'T put white text on brand green (#B8FF3C) — contrast fails. On-brand text is near-black by rule.
- DON'T use feedback colors for decoration; they carry state meaning only.
- DON'T use brand green to signal success or vice-versa. `feedback.success` (#A3FC11) is deliberately close to brand green but means "success," not "brand" — keep them semantically distinct.

# Distilled rationale rules
# ↑ Every design decision the team makes must be distilled into an
#   imperative rule and appended here. Example:
#   - NEVER use `gy-300` for text. Decorative use only (contrast fails on light bg).
